card.name: The word review in instructions
card.fires_on: The word "review" (or "reviewed") used as an instruction in drug-label text. It usually starts a clause after a comma or period, e.g. review medical history, medications, or the prescribing information.

modes.label: Review after a condition
modes.description: "review" opens an instruction right after a comma that follows a "before starting" or "on administration of" clause.
modes.example: Before starting TRIUMEQ or TRIUMEQ PD,<< review>> medical history for prior exposure to any ab

modes.label: Review starting a sentence
modes.description: "Review" begins a sentence telling the reader to consult the prescribing information.
modes.example: [see Indications and Usage ( 1.1 ), Dosage and Administration ( 2.1 )] .<< Review>> the prescribing information for EDURANT for
